name: NCD program registry cohort
description: NCD-registry patients (all clinical statuses except waitlist) with conditions pivoted to columns and the latest exit-survey info.

name: Follow-up NCD consultations
description: Patients with a second or later consultation in the NCD program during the reporting month.
numerator_description: Patients with consultation_number > 1 in ds__ncd_consultations during the period

name: New NCD consultations
description: Patients whose first lifetime consultation in the NCD program falls in the reporting month.
numerator_description: Patients with consultation_number = 1 in ds__ncd_consultations during the period
